title: Illegal harvesting, transport and trade
rule: Without lawful authority or excuse it is an offence to harvest forest produce, carry or transport produce harvested illegally, sell or buy it, or stock it.
points: Also: marking timber without being an authorised grader, and exporting without a valid export certificate.
Forest produce includes trees and timber.
Covers vehicles and carrying by hand.
The burden of proving lawful authority or excuse is on the accused.
checks: Where and how it was harvested
penalty: Fine of TSh 1,000,000 or three times the market value, whichever is greater, or 2 to 7 years in prison, or both.
flag: Confirm with a legal officer how s. 89(a) and s. 85 apply to felling outside reserves.
